brief:
Israeli forces killed at least six Palestinians in attacks on Gaza, including a father and child, according to reports. The deaths occurred as Israel continues military operations in the enclave following last year's ceasefire agreement.

The Gaza Health Ministry reported that Israel has killed more than 1,600 people in Gaza since the ceasefire took effect, Al Jazeera English reported. The figure reflects ongoing violence in the territory despite the agreement meant to halt hostilities.
dek: Israel has killed more than 1,600 people in Gaza since last year's 'ceasefire', the enclave's Health Ministry says.
title: Israeli attacks kill father, child among six Palestinians in Gaza
